title: Just Auth
description: Just Auth and a little performance
body:
# JustAuth

## Why you should download this auth plugin
Forces players to register and log in before interacting  
Easy to use and highly configurable  
Supports hex and &0-9 &a-f color codes  
Secure passwords hashed with bcrypt  
Supports aliases like /l and /reg  

## Commands

`/register <password>` - Register a new account  
`/login <password>` - Login to your account  
`/changepass <old> <new>` - Change your password
